tasks.label: SE3 · Onshore wind
tasks.method: Hourly-trained quantile model; each hour repeated on the 15-minute grid
limitations: Quarter-hour output repeats hourly distributions; native sub-hourly skill has not been established.
The nominal 80% interval is too narrow in the winter development evaluation.
Fleet availability, icing and capacity drift remain open sources of error.

tasks.label: DE-LU · Solar
tasks.method: Native 15-minute solar quantiles over a physical PV model
limitations: The fleet is approximated by six sites with a fixed orientation mix.
Annual installed-capacity snapshots have no recoverable publication vintages.
Headline metrics use daylight only; seasonal bias and fleet assumptions still need investigation.
